basis: Author manuscript expressly describes public release of this benchmark to support research and points to this exact code/materials repository. data_boundary: Allowlisted task fields only. Exclude demographics, survey/free-response fields, raw participant IDs and metadata from reader inputs and Git.
prior_archive_receipt: Acquisition-only review remains intact; this separate subsequent review supplies the bounded analysis basis.
read_portions: paper introduction/release intent, Methods 2.1, model methods 3.3 and conclusion/materials pointer; repository Methods and navigation; pinned task shuffling and response encoding
scope_limit: Source-specific research-use interpretation, not an asserted open dataset license or permission for raw redistribution, commercial training, participant profiling or contact. The manuscript personal-copy permission is not treated as a general dataset license.
